capabilities: Open web links in Web viewer or browser with a modifier click
Flip the default link target from the status bar
Run commands to open the link under cursor in either target
Hand the current Web viewer page over to the browser
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.0+ on desktop; without the Web viewer core plugin, links fall back to the browser. README discloses AI-assisted code generation (Claude).
intentEvidence: With the Web viewer core plugin, every external link opens inside Obsidian.
problem: With the Web viewer core plugin, all external links open inside Obsidian, and switching to the browser requires a right-click menu detour.
summary: Link-click helper that lets you choose per click whether a web link opens in Obsidian's Web viewer or your system browser.
